info.title: Hashlark API
info.description: Search many torrent indexers at once. All routes except /health and /openapi.json need `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

get.summary: API keys that can sign in to this server.

post.summary: Creates an API key. The key is returned only in this response.
Validates a definition without saving it.
Converts a Jackett (Cardigann) definition. Nothing is saved.
Runs a definition once, live, without saving it.

put.summary: Saves a result from a recent search.

get.summary: State of built-in Tor (connecting, ready, or not running).
Lists every provider with its state and health.

post.summary: Adds a provider. Re-adding a definition with the same id updates it.

patch.summary: Changes a provider (enable/disable, rename, network policy).

post.summary:
Stores cookies from a browser check the user completed on the site
(desktop "Open site to continue").

get.summary: Definition repositories, including the built-in one.

post.summary: Adds a signed definition repository. Its providers are added disabled.

delete.summary: Removes a repository and its providers.

post.summary: Fetches a repository's latest definitions now.
Gets the magnet link or `.torrent` URL for a result.

get.summary: A result from a recent search.
Streams a search as Server-Sent Events.
get.description:
Event names: `provider_started`, `results`, `provider_finished`,
`provider_failed`, `done`. Each event's data is the JSON of a
`SearchEvent`. `results` items with an `id` seen before replace it.
Closing the connection cancels the search.

parameters.name: providers
parameters.description: Comma-separated provider ids. Default: all enabled providers.

parameters.name: imdb
parameters.description: IMDb id, for providers that support it.

post.summary: Runs a search to completion and returns sorted results.

put.summary: Replaces all settings. Fields left out take their defaults.

post.summary: Fetches a page for the definition editor's element picker.
Downloads the tracker list from the configured URL now.

Capabilities.description: What kinds of query a provider supports.

Category.description: Content category. Providers map their own category ids onto these.

valid.description: Whether the result passes validation as is.

warnings.description: Things that couldn't be converted exactly; review them.

name.description: What the key is for, e.g. "Phone" or "Sonarr".

DefinitionCheck.description: Result of checking a definition without saving it.

custom_url.description: Custom DoH endpoint, used when `resolver` is `custom`.

fallback_to_system.description: Fall back to the system resolver if DoH fails.

torrent_dir.description: Where `.torrent` files are saved. `None` means the OS downloads folder.

DownloadTarget.description: What to hand to the OS to start a download.

oneOf.description: For `provider_error`: what went wrong with the provider.

saved_at.description: Unix ms when it was saved.

FetchedPage.description: A page fetched for the definition editor.

HealthState.description: Overall state shown next to a provider.

disabled_until.description: Unix ms until which the provider is skipped, if auto-disabled.

last_checked_at.description: Unix ms of the last attempt.

success_rate.description: Share of successful attempts in the recent window.

append_default_trackers.description: Add the default trackers to magnets that already list their own.

trackers_url.description: URL of a plain-text tracker list (one per line), refreshed daily.

MergedResult.description:
A result after de-duplication across providers. This is what front ends
display.

id.description:
Stable id: derived from the infohash when known, so the same torrent
keeps its id across searches.

leechers.description: Highest leecher count reported by any source.

primary.description:
Best combined view of the result. Missing fields are filled in from
other sources as they arrive.

seeders.description: Highest seeder count reported by any source.

sources.description: Every provider that returned this torrent, in arrival order.

per_host_rate.description: Requests per second allowed to one host.

NewApiKey.description: A newly created key. The key itself is shown only once.

settings.description: Setting values (`cfg.*`) to use for this run only.

ProviderId.description: Stable identifier of a provider, e.g. `internet-archive`.

ProviderKind.description: How a provider is implemented (see ADR 0005).

ProviderOutcome.description: Result of one provider in a completed search.

ProviderPatch.description: Changes to a provider. Absent fields are left as they are.

settings.description: Setting values to change; `null` clears one.

repo_id.description: Repository it came from; `null` if imported by hand.

ProviderView.description: A provider as shown to users.

builtin.description: Shipped with Hashlark: can be disabled but not removed.

error.description: Why the provider couldn't be loaded (e.g. an invalid definition).

fetched.description: Trackers fetched from the list URL.

RepoView.description: A definition repository as shown to users.

builtin.description: Shipped with Hashlark; can't be removed.

fingerprint.description: Short form of the pinned signing key.

oneOf.description: Ask for a magnet or a `.torrent` when the result allows it.

Route.description: How a provider's traffic is routed.

oneOf.description:
New or updated merged results. An item whose `id` was sent before
replaces the earlier version.

SearchEvent.description:
Progress of a running search, in the order it happens. Front ends render
these as they arrive; the HTTP API forwards them as SSE events.

SearchOutcome.description: A completed search: sorted results plus how each provider did.

SearchResult.description: One result as returned by one provider.

needs_resolve.description:
The download link is only available after [`resolve`] (e.g. it is on
the provider's details page).

[`resolve`]: crate::provider::SearchProvider::resolve

cache_ttl_secs.description: How long identical searches are served from cache, in seconds. 0 disables caching.

provider_timeout_secs.description: How long one provider may take, in seconds.

Session.description: Cookies from a browser check the user completed on the site.

expires_at.description: Unix ms; defaults to 24 hours from now.

user_agent.description: The browser's user agent; challenge cookies only work with it.

SessionCookie.description: One cookie from a browser session.

SettingView.description: A user-configurable setting of a provider.

is_set.description: Whether a value is stored (useful for passwords).

SortOrder.description: How the merged result list is ordered.

repo_id.description: The repository it came from; `None` if imported by hand.

added.description: New providers (added disabled, for the user to review).

errors.description: Definitions that were skipped, and why.

TargetKind.description: Which kind of [`DownloadTarget`] a caller would rather have.

TestReport.description: Outcome of a manual provider test.

mode.description:
Use Hashlark's built-in Tor, or a Tor already running on this
computer (at `socks_url`).

socks_url.description:
SOCKS address of a running Tor (Tor Browser uses port 9150, the Tor
service and Orbot 9050).

TorStatus.description: State of Tor, for the UI.

built_in.description: Built-in Tor is available in this build.

first_run_done.description: Set once the user has finished the first-run screen.

check_for_updates.description: Check GitHub Releases for new versions.
